notes: Hostile source-only fidelity audit against data/bill-text/119-HR-3535.txt (Introduced-in-House text, entire 1,789-char source read in full) plus registered referencedSource usc-52-30121 (52 U.S.C. 30121, the FECA sec. 319 statute the bill amends). No material or minor fidelity errors. The entire operative content verifies verbatim: SEC. 2(a) amends 52 U.S.C. 30121(a)(1)(A) by inserting ', including a State or local ballot initiative or referendum or recall election' after 'State, or local election'; SEC. 2(b) makes it prospective ('contributions and donations made on or after the date of the enactment'). The analysis correctly notes SEC. 2 leaves the subsec (b) 'foreign national' definition untouched (confirmed against the referenced statute). Direction sub-check clean: every effect claim is extend/expand/widen, matching the insertion (no inversion). Coverage complete: the bill's three elements (short title, the insertion amendment incl. recall elections, prospective effective date) are all surfaced; no material omission. Three likelihoodReason rows are structural metadata, not bill-content claims: sponsor 'Mr. Fitzpatrick' IS named in the introduced text (party R-PA is metadata); '2 cosponsors' is post-introduction metadata (introduced text names only Mr. Golden as co-introducer); 'Cleared the House' is not in the IH source but is confirmed by votes[] (Passed House, Voice Vote, 2026-07-13) with no stage/vote drift. OUT OF SCOPE: featured_quotes and criticisms are Congressional Record floor statements absent from the bill text, and no CR referencedSource is registered, so they cannot be verified against the available source; not adjudicated here.
